atlas: Timm-Nissl multiplane microscopic atlas of the rat brain: coronal Nissl (thionine) series H108c, registered to Waxholm Space
source: EBRAINS, Deep Zoom pyramids and QuickNII/VisuAlign registration of H108c
citation: Blixhavn C. H. et al. 2023, A Timm-Nissl multiplane microscopic atlas of rat brain zincergic terminal fields and metal-containing glia, Scientific Data 10:150, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02012-6; dataset https://doi.org/10.25493/T686-7BX
derived: One reduced level of each image pyramid, resampled onto the coronal plane of the viewer (flat skull, mm from Bregma, 39 µm) with the published QuickNII and VisuAlign registration; contrast stretched (one linear map for the three channels) and the bare slide made transparent; WebP (nissl.py). Changes made by SYNAPTICA. Not combined with any atlas file.
